'''Vampire Hunter''' is a sub-race for Humans.

== How to Become ==
To become a Vampire Hunter, you must be Human. Go to the windmill tower near the Merchant in front of the Vampire Castle. Find and talk to the quest NPC. Accept and complete the Vampire Hunter quest.
[[File:Vampire-hunter-windmill-tower.png|thumb|The windmill tower near the Merchant in front of the Vampire Castle]]

== Abilities ==
Completing the quest unlocks Neck Snap and Barrage.

== Rewards ==
* Throwing Knife — quest reward.

== Weapons ==
* '''Rapier''' — available at the Weapons Shop in the second village for 3 WoodStake + 15 Silver Bar.
